limitations: Budget: at most 3 rounds, 3 candidates per round, 9 adaptive tests executed per run (server-enforced).
Candidates run only through allowlisted mock tools; nothing is executed and no network request is made.
A candidate 'passes' when the observed policy decisions equal its expected decisions; that is evidence about the mock gate, not about a real agent runtime.
